summary.text: Jim Buck is a Republican who has represented Indiana Senate District 21 since 2008, after serving in the Indiana House of Representatives from 1994 to 2008.
He chairs the Senate Local Government Committee and is listed as Majority Floor Leader Emeritus.

paragraphs.text: According to his Indiana Senate Republican biography, Buck holds a B.A., B.S. and M.B.A. from Indiana Wesleyan University and is a retired real estate broker.
His district comprises Tipton County and portions of Hamilton and Howard counties.
Beyond Local Government, he sits on the Environmental Affairs; Homeland Security and Transportation; Judiciary; Rules and Legislative Procedure; and Veterans Affairs and The Military committees.
The page lists his activities as including the We Care Board, the Learning Network Board, the Rotary Club and Mason Lodge 93, and says he is married to Judy and has five daughters.
